items.title: Week 2 Announcements
items.text: Lab open Friday 11:30–4 with peer instructors, and 5% extra credit for finishing Quiz 1 and Code Review 1 early. Monday Sep 7 the college is closed (Labor Day). Tuesday Sep 8: optional quiz review 9:30–10 am in 118 HN, and Homework 1 is due 5 pm on Gradescope.

items.title: Semester start: lab hours and lecture slides
items.text: 1001E HN lab hours: Monday–Thursday 11:30 am–5:15 pm, Friday 11:30 am–4:00 pm, when classes meet. Lecture slides are posted on Brightspace on Tuesdays at 9 am.
